# data-access-patterns

Cache-aside/read-through/write-through, TTL and invalidation, N+1, bounded reads and idempotent writes - the pattern vocabulary the data.* facts classify into.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-001` | high | KEYS command scans the whole keyspace |
| `AF-DATA-002` | medium | Write without a visible TTL |
| `AF-DATA-003` | critical | FLUSHALL drops every database |
| `AF-DATA-004` | high | FLUSHDB drops the current database |
| `AF-DATA-005` | high | CONFIG rewrites server behavior at runtime |
| `AF-DATA-006` | high | DEBUG is an unsafe introspection command |
| `AF-DATA-007` | medium | MONITOR streams every command |
| `AF-DATA-008` | high | SAVE blocks the server synchronously |
| `AF-DATA-009` | high | DynamoDB Scan without limit or filter |
| `AF-DATA-010` | medium | DynamoDB Query without a key condition |
| `AF-DATA-011` | medium | MongoDB find/aggregate without a limit |
| `AF-DATA-012` | critical | MongoDB filtered write with an empty filter |
| `AF-DATA-013` | medium | Neptune traversal/query without a limit |
